> [!TIP]
> **AI-Assisted Issue Resolution**: This project utilizes AI-assisted development tools to triage, diagnose, and expedite the resolution of issues. The more detailed and comprehensive the information you provide (exact URLs, browser/OS environment, reproduction steps, and screenshots), the faster AI tooling and maintainers can diagnose root causes and deliver verified fixes.

**Affected Page or URL**
ex. `https://carlkidcrypto.github.io/` or specific blog / project page

**Browser and Device**
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge]
- OS / Platform: [e.g. macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, Linux]
- Theme Mode: [e.g. Light mode, Dark mode, System default]

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the issue is (broken link, formatting defect, broken image/diagram, typo, etc.).

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Navigate to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. See error or visual defect

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Additional context**
Add any other contextual information about the problem here.

**Do you have a fix already with working code?**
Consider opening a pull request with your fix! Ensure local documentation builds pass cleanly via `make html`.
